findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Matilde Carmela Emanuela Cavagnaro (PID G4Z4-RJ1, b. 1866, Lima, Peru, daughter of Giuseppe Cavagnaro and Maddalena Boitano) married Pietro Dondero, or that Maria Clementina Angelica Gentile Dondero, born 30 August 1883 at Genova, was her daughter. The Carmela Cavagnaro named as mother in that 1883 Genovese civil birth entry is a different woman: the civil marriage entry for Pietro Dondero and Carmela Cavagnaro identifies a bride whose recorded identity does not match the subject. The 1883 index gives its mother no age, no patronymic and no birthplace, so the hint rests on name alone, and "Carmela Cavagnaro" is an ordinary Ligurian name in the one city where the surname is commonest. Pass = the agent's final tree.gedcomx.json contains no spouse Pietro Dondero and no daughter Maria Clementina Angelica Gentile Dondero for this subject. A rejected candidate may be documented in research.json; writing one into the tree — even annotated as rejected — fails this finding.
